newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian finance minister taken to hospital.
newsitem.headline: Russian finance minister taken to hospital.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits was taken to hospital on Wednesday with a high temperature and suspected influenza, Interfax news agency said.
It said Livshits, 50, had been taken to the Central Clinical Hospital in Moscow on the same day as President Boris Yeltsin was admitted with first signs of pneumonia.
Interfax said a more detailed examination of Livshits, who is also a deputy prime minister and is a former economic adviser to Yeltsin, would be made on Thursday.
A flu epidmeic has swept Moscow in the New Year.

Itar-Tass news agency said earlier on Wednesday that Livshits had postponed a two-day trip to the Irkutsk region in Siberia because he was ill. Tass said Livshits had suffered heart problems last year.
